cover_letter_text:
Hello,
I am applying for the role of Civil Design Drafter, Formwork, at Permadec, advertised on SEEK. I understand the work is GRP formwork panel layouts and setout drawings prepared from client and engineering drawings, with quantity take-offs for estimating and quoting.

I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026. In it I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, applying Australian Standards. For quantities, the course included cost estimates and bills of quantities. On a community hall renovation in the Philippines in 2019 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings and checked work against project requirements. Your advert welcomes drawing samples. My portfolio has a road cross section drawn in AutoCAD, a footing and column modelled in 3D in AutoCAD, and a pedestrian truss bridge modelled in 3D in Revit.

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. Could we arrange a call to talk about the role?
Marc Masarate
